questions.description: Path (relative to the manifest) of the jevi question set. Every question must be atomic and written in English.

ask.description: Question id inside that set whose verdict decides this check.

expect.description: The verdict that means the check PASSES. `no` makes the check a tripwire: it can only ever fire.

facts.description: Optional executable (relative to the manifest) run once per file. It prints a JSON object of DETERMINISTIC facts the code resolved on jev's behalf — the pointers jev cannot follow. Merged into the state next to the artefact.

pin_model.description: Model id prefix recorded with every verdict. A longer, dated id (typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917) turns a silent model rotation into `unsure` instead of a changed answer.

mode.description: gate: the check GRANTS green, so `unsure` must escalate to a human and never pass. tripwire: the check only ever FIRES, so `unsure` is silence — and the check proves nothing when it stays quiet. Pick tripwire only when measurement shows jev answers confidently on the defect and abstains on the healthy case. shadow: runs, records every verdict to .musts/jev-shadow/, and grants and blocks NOTHING — the only honest way to start, and the only way to accumulate the labelled rows a threshold needs.
